name: 洛薇
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:3119
who: Lowei, a woodland elf and former tower warden who came down from the wall in the year 8 of the bronze age and has kept the rain city's book-house for six hundred and fifty years; in 661 she looks thirty-five or thirty-six: about 176 cm, tall and thin with a slight forward stoop from reading. Very short silver-grey hair cropped at the nape, the tip of her left pointed ear missing a small notch where a falling stone struck it on the wall. Pale green eyes that she holds very close to the page, because she says she spent centuries looking at far distances. No spectacles. A faded warden's cloak whose green has washed out to grey, ink on her fingertips. A slow, dry, patient air; she records every borrowed book and when it should come back. The tip of her left pointed ear (on the viewer's right when she faces us) has a clearly visible small V-shaped notch bitten out of it, drawn in every panel; her right pointed ear is intact.
face: FACE, as in the references: an angular, narrow woman's face of about thirty-five, pale green slightly nearsighted eyes with a patient half-lowered gaze, a straight nose, thin eyebrows, a small dry closed mouth, faint fine lines at the eye corners, clean fair skin; the left pointed ear has a small notch missing from its tip (on the viewer's right when they face us).
build: 176 cm, tall and thin, long-limbed with narrow shoulders and a slight stoop.
palette: pale lichen green, faded warden grey, old paper cream, lamp amber, a little ink black
casual: Her book-house clothes: an old warden's cloak, its green long since faded to grey, worn open over a plain long-sleeved dress of grey-green wool with the cuffs stained by ink, a narrow leather belt from which hangs a thick ledger on a cord, soft flat boots. In one hand she holds a small brass oil lamp and in the other an open book, her face tipped close over the page. A dry, patient look.
private: Alone in the stone cellar under the book-house: the cloak off and folded on a shelf, sleeves pushed up past the elbow, a shawl of undyed wool over the shoulders, the ledger open on a barrel beside the lamp. She holds a heavy bound manuscript against her chest with both arms and looks over it, calm.
battle: Hauling the shelves down in the night: the grey cloak tied back, sleeves rolled and tied, leather gloves, a canvas sling across the chest taking the weight of a stack of books. In one hand a small lantern lifted to show the cellar steps, the other arm clutching one last tall stack of books to her chest; no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the cellar-hauling outfit: the grey cloak tied back, sleeves rolled, a canvas sling across the chest, one arm clutching a tall stack of books to her chest, the other hand lifting a small lantern to light the steps; no weapon, the eyes on the stairs, a calm, determined look.
formal: At a long-table sitting in the rain city: a grey-green wool surcoat with an open collar and wide turned-back cuffs over a pale dress, the faded warden's cloak pinned at one shoulder with a small bronze leaf brooch, the thick ledger hanging on its cord. Fine pale-green runes in the cloak's hem brighten faintly as she moves. She stands with her hands folded, a measured, polite look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale green eyes looking down at the viewer from very close as if reading your name off the page, the notched left ear tip catching the light. Warm lamplight from one side against dim shelves. Foreground blur: paper edges, drifting dust and the curl of an open ledger. She wears the faded warden's cloak.

name: 瑟维安·夜绯
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:3140
who: Servian of the Night-Crimson house, a succubus demon-kin and the house's head, who speaks at the long table for the four gentle camps nearest the wall and is spending the week before the signing in the rain city; in 661 he looks just over forty: about 180 cm, slender and upright. Silver-white hair combed straight back, a single streak of grey at each temple. Dark crimson eyes, calm and exact. Pale skin. Short pointed ears. Dark red gloves whose black silk wrist bands are worn through in places. A soft-spoken, orderly air; he counts everything aloud and lets his hands lie open on the table.
build: about 180 cm, slender and upright with narrow shoulders.
palette: night crimson and dark wine, silver-white hair, black silk, pale skin, a little tarnished brass
casual: His long-table clothes: a dark crimson long coat of the plain western cut closed with small black buttons to the throat, over a black waistcoat and white shirt, dark red gloves with a black silk band at each wrist, the silk worn through on the left, black trousers and polished boots. A slim ledger of accounts under one arm. A composed, courteous look.
private: In his lodging in the rain city: the coat off, a dark wine long-sleeved shirt with a high soft collar, the gloves laid beside a lamp, the bare hands flat on a table covered with figures. A tired, attentive look.
battle: Seated at the long table: the crimson coat closed to the throat, the dark red gloves taken off and laid side by side on the wooden table, both bare hands spread flat and open beside them, palms down; nothing held. A level, quiet look.
battle_pose: 3) the long-table outfit: seated upright, the dark crimson coat buttoned to the throat, the dark red gloves taken off and laid side by side on the wooden table in front of him, both bare hands spread flat and open beside them, palms down; nothing held, a level, quiet look.
formal: At the signing of the grey-rain pact: a floor-length black formal coat left open over a dark crimson waistcoat, a deep draped shawl collar, a dark red silk sash, clean dark red gloves with new black silk wrist bands, the silver hair combed back. Small ember-red points of light drift in the silk bands. He stands very straight with the hands folded in front, a calm, grave look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the dark crimson eyes looking at the viewer with a still courtesy, the silver streaks at the temples catching the light, a gloved hand resting near the collar. Warm lamplight from one side with a cooler dusk on the other. Foreground blur: the edge of a long wooden table, a pair of folded dark red gloves and a candle flame. He wears the crimson coat closed to the throat.

name: 托尔贝
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:3141
who: Torbe, a flame-horn demon-kin baker who bakes the bread that both sides of the long table eat in the rain city's kitchen; in 661 he looks fifty: about 165 cm, short and thickset with strong forearms. Two horns sweeping back from the brow, the tips chipped; ruddy warm skin; short salt-and-pepper hair; warm brown eyes. When he laughs a single gold tooth shows. Flour on his forearms. A short, blunt, kindly air; he thinks in loaves and says things like 'both sides must eat the same'.
build: about 165 cm, short and thickset, strong round forearms and a broad back.
palette: flour white, warm ruddy brown, oven ember orange, gold tooth, worn wool grey
casual: His baking clothes: a cloth cap with two round holes cut for the horns, a long flour-dusted white apron over a rolled-sleeve undyed linen shirt and brown wool trousers, wooden clogs. He carries a long-handled wooden bread peel over one shoulder with a round loaf resting on it, flour on the forearms, a broad closed-mouth smile with the gold tooth just showing.
private: At the back of the kitchen late at night: the apron off, a loose wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, a folded cloth around the neck. He holds a heel of dark rye bread in one hand and a mug in the other, sitting on a flour sack, a warm tired smile.
battle: Standing his ground when the night turns bad: the leather-trimmed apron tied tight, the cap pulled down over the horn holes, thick oven gloves. He grips the long iron-tipped oven rake in both hands across his body like a bar, a stubborn, planted stance, the jaw set.
formal: On the morning of the signing: a clean white apron over a fresh dark wool coat of the plain western cut, the cap off, the chipped horn tips bare, two big baskets of loaves set in front of him. He stands with the hands on the baskets' edges, a proud, calm look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the warm brown eyes crinkled, a gold tooth catching the light, the chipped horn tips overhead. Orange glow from an oven mouth on one side against cool early-morning window light. Foreground blur: drifting flour, a round loaf and the edge of a bread peel. He wears the floury apron and the horned cap.

name: 巴尔缇娜·格雷恩
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:3149
who: Baltina Grayne, the Grey Witch of the west, a long-lived demon-kin found as a baby in the last basket in the rain city's south gate, now leading the survivors of the burned city west; her body has started growing again after the night by the dark river, so she looks sixteen or seventeen: about 158 cm, slim and straight-backed, wholly covered by her clothes. Long straight ash-grey hair worn loose, the first silver coming through, no plait. Gold eyes that stay faintly lit even by day. A tiny ember-red mark at one temple. Short pointed ears. Pale cool skin, grey ash always on her fingers. A calm, tired, serious air; she asks your name first and writes it down.
palette: ash grey and road grey, black leather, a little mountain-copper gold, one small ember red
casual: Her road clothes in the first years of the caravan: a long deep grey coat with a high collar closed to the throat, the hem frayed from walking, over a plain dark high-necked long-sleeved dress and dark leggings, a pair of black leather gloves on both hands, scuffed boots newly bought; a small leather-bound notebook hanging from her belt on a cord. She holds a pen of grey ink, ready to write a name, a calm, serious look.
private: By the caravan fire at night: a soft long-sleeved grey wool dress with a high neck, the black gloves off and laid on her knee, grey ash on her bare fingers, the hair loose over one shoulder, a scorched pair of old boots set beside her. She holds a heel of bread, the same ration as everyone. A quiet, tired look.
battle: On the road after a bad night: a grey hooded cloak over the long deep grey coat, the black gloves on, riding boots, the notebook at her belt. In one hand, held low and pointed at the ground, a plain short black-powder pistol of her own making with no runes cut in it; the other hand open at her side. A still, level look, the mouth closed.
formal: At the long signing table of the caravan's first pact: a long black dress with plain sleeves under a deep grey wool cape that fastens with a single clasp at the throat, the black gloves on, the hair tied back with a plain cord, a sheet of pact laid in front of her and a grey pen. A faint ring of grey sparks circles the pen tip. She stands upright with the hands folded, a grave, composed look.
art: A portrait cropped at the chest, the face large, the eyes open and serious, the gold eyes looking straight at the viewer as if asking your name, the mouth closed, one black-gloved hand holding a notebook near her collar. Cold grey dawn light from one side, a faint ember glow from a campfire on the other. Foreground blur: falling grey ash and drifting embers.

name: 帕维尔
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:3190
who: Pavel, a stonecutter of the rain city's carvers' guild and the first of the monument-carvers who went west with the Grey Witch's caravan; in 661 he is twenty-one: about 168 cm, short and stocky, with wide strong hands, the top joint of the right index finger missing from a chisel accident in his apprentice years (on the viewer's left when they face us). Cropped light-brown hair grey with stone dust, steady grey-green eyes, a square plain face. He talks slowly and in every other sentence asks who was there.
build: about 168 cm, short and stocky, thick forearms, wide hands, a broad back.
palette: stone-dust grey, light brown, leather apron brown, bronze plate gleam, linen cream
casual: His carving clothes: a heavy brown leather apron scorched at one corner over an undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, canvas trousers, hobnailed boots. A roll of steel chisels tucked in his belt, a wooden mallet in his right hand, and in his left arm a blank bronze plate wrapped in a bundled apron-cloth, held to his chest. A patient, serious look.
private: At night by the wagon: the apron hung on a peg, a plain linen shirt open at the throat, the sleeves rolled, stone dust washed from his hands. He holds a chisel to the lamplight to look along its edge, a quiet, tired look.
battle: The working stance of a carver: the leather apron tied tight, leather wrist straps, a cap against flying chips. He grips a chisel set slanted against a slab of black glassy stone in one hand and the mallet raised in the other, the weight forward on one foot, an intent look.
formal: At a pact-reading: a dark grey wool work coat with an open turned-down collar over a white shirt, a leather chisel roll tied at the belt, a small stone-dust pouch, the right hand missing the top joint of the index finger. Fine white lines like cracks of light run along the steel chisel tips. He stands with his hands folded in front, a grave look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the grey-green eyes steady and asking who was there, stone dust in the hair, the shortened right index finger visible against the chisel. Warm lamplight from one side on pale rock. Foreground blur: drifting stone chips, a chisel tip and the edge of a bronze plate.

name: 祖拉克
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:3207
who: Zulak, a demon-kin blood-collector who leads a band of six or seven riders and a covered cage-wagon along the western rivers, collecting the blood-tax for a high seat; he looks about fifty: about 160 cm, short and wide-shouldered. Iron-grey hair combed flat, clean-shaven, a pale square face, pale brown eyes. Short pointed ears. His hands are always scrupulously clean, the nails trimmed straight, though he has cut wrists for decades. A thin curved bleeding-knife at the waist. Courteous, measured and polite, keeps to the letter of every oath.
build: about 160 cm, short, wide-shouldered and thick through the chest.
palette: iron grey, rust red, glossy black lacquer, pale skin, tarnished brass
casual: His collector's clothes: a dark charcoal long coat of the plain western cut with the collar buttoned up under the chin, small brass buttons, dark trousers and tall boots, clean bare hands, a thin curved bleeding-knife in a plain sheath at his belt. At his feet a black-lacquered box with the seal of his high seat on its lid. A courteous, unreadable look.
private: By his wagon at dusk: the coat unbuttoned at the collar, a plain grey wool shirt, sitting on the lacquered box and washing his clean hands in a bowl, a quiet look.
battle: On the road with his work: the charcoal coat buttoned under the chin, a short black cloak, black riding gloves, the thin curved knife sheathed and untouched. He holds the black lacquered box against his chest with both hands, standing perfectly still, a polite, flat look.
battle_pose: 3) the oath-keeping outfit: standing perfectly still on a river bank in the buttoned charcoal coat and short black cloak, the black lacquered box held against his chest in both hands, the thin knife sheathed and untouched at his belt; a polite, flat look.
formal: At a swearing before a camp elder: a black long coat of western cut with a wide shoulder cape, a red sash across the chest, a silver seal of his high seat on a chain, the black gloves taken off, the bare clean hands held out open in oath. Faint red rune lines run along the sash edge like ruled lines in a ledger. A grave, courteous look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale brown eyes level and exact, the buttoned collar under his chin, the clean hands folded at his chest. Dim red lantern light from one side against dark river reeds. Foreground blur: drifting reed fluff, a black lacquered box edge and a thread of mist.

name: 前帝
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:3272
who: The old emperor, the tenth sovereign of the dawn empire since the sword-taking rite, nameless in the records; crowned in 639, he loses his crown in a single night in 668, aged fifty-five, and retires to a hunting lodge on the river bay: about 172 cm, thin, the shoulders slightly stooped. Hair gone mostly grey, a pale face from twenty-nine years indoors, a ring of whiter skin round the forehead where the crown pressed. Pale hazel eyes. Long fingers, short nails, a writing callus on the right middle finger. A slow, courteous voice; he asks many questions and answers few.
build: about 172 cm, thin, a slight stoop, long thin hands.
palette: dawn white and old gold, pale grey, river blue-green, a faint ink black
casual: His life after abdication at the river lodge: a plain long coat of undyed grey wool of the plain western cut, buttoned to the collar, over a white linen shirt, plain trousers and soft old boots, a walking stick with a worn grip. The whiter band across the forehead plainly visible, the hands folded on the stick. A mild, thoughtful look.
private: Early morning on the lodge steps: a long wool robe over a linen shirt, soft slippers, a shawl over the shoulders, a cup in both hands, watching boats on the river. A quiet, mild look. The robe is a European house robe closing down the front with plain round buttons, fitted sleeves, plain long trousers beneath; the front is not crossed over and there is no wide sash or pleated skirt.
battle: Seated on a stone bench by the river in the plain grey coat, a thin gold crown laid across his knees with both long hands resting on it, the head slightly bowed, the eyes on the water; nothing else held.
battle_pose: 3) the unmoved outfit: seated on a stone bench by the river in the plain grey coat, a thin gold crown laid across his knees with both long hands resting on it, the head slightly bowed, the eyes on the water; nothing else held, a quiet, still look.
formal: At the spring feast on the night of the crown: a long dawn-white and old-gold court mantle over a gold-edged tunic, an open wide neckline, a gold kite embroidered at the breast with spread wings, a thin gold crown on the head, a gold sash. Warm light follows the gold thread in slow pulses. He stands very upright, hands folded in front, a grave, composed look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale hazel eyes steady, the band of whiter skin round the forehead clearly visible, the lips closed. Soft grey river-morning light from one side. Foreground blur: drifting river mist and the gleam of a gold crown on a knee.

name: 梅尔基奥·施特伦
src: 山铜纪/山铜纪时段_四_黎明的年月.md:3334
who: Melchior Strehlen, a human paladin of the old line of the Stellar Church and the commander of the Thorn-Crowned Order at the White Fir Keep, aged sixty-two in 690: about 188 cm, tall and lean with a straight back. White hair shaved close to the scalp, the skin drawn tight over the bones of his face, pale blue eyes. On the ring finger of his left hand an iron ring bearing a star crown wrapped in thorns (on the viewer's right when they face us). A slow, quiet voice that never rises; he always speaks of the god first and never asks anyone's name.
build: about 188 cm, tall and lean, straight-backed, long arms.
palette: surcoat white, old mail grey, thorn dark green, iron grey, pale blue
casual: His order's dress: a long white surcoat with a star crown wrapped in a thorn branch stitched on the chest, over an old worn mail shirt, a plain leather belt, grey wool trousers and heavy boots, an iron ring on the left ring finger. A long straight sword held point-down before him with both hands resting on the pommel. A stern, quiet, level look.
private: In the keep chapel at dusk: the surcoat off, a plain long-sleeved grey wool robe with a prayer cord at the waist, the white head bowed over a worn prayer book held in both hands. A quiet, severe look.
battle: Standing perfectly upright in the white surcoat over old mail, both hands resting on the pommel of a long sword planted point-down before him, a bundle of thorn switches hung at his belt; the face stern and still, the mouth closed.
formal: At the order's founding in a small chapel: a long white ceremonial surcoat with the thorn-wrapped star crown stitched large on the chest, a white mantle, the iron ring, the sword held upright before him in both hands. He stands very straight, a grave look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale blue eyes level and cold, the close-shaved white hair, the thorn-crown stitching at the collar. Hard white morning light from one side with a thin yellow glow behind. Foreground blur: a blade edge, thorn twigs and dust. He wears the white surcoat over old mail.
